title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.02203v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for Recursive Self-Improving AI (RSI) by adapting Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) on unlabeled test inputs, using self-consensus rewards derived from majority voting over sampled rollouts. However, majority voting can mistake popularity for correctness: a spurious yet high-frequency unverified consensus may become a biased reward signal, causing test-time RL to reinforce frequent but wrong answers and collapse into an incorrect mode. We address this false-popular failure mode with T$^3$RL (Tool-Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning), a verification-aware test-time RL framework. T$^3$RL grounds pseudo-label construction in external tool evidence. Concretely, a verifier utilizes external tool evidence (e.g., from code execution) to upweight verified rollouts during a verification-aware voting, producing more reliable pseudo-labels for training.

translated_title: 测试时强化学习的工具验证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.02203v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：测试时强化学习（TTRL）已成为递归自我改进人工智能（RSI）的一种有前景的范式，通过在未标记的测试输入上调整大型推理模型（LRMs），利用基于采样轨迹多数投票得出的自一致奖励。然而，多数投票可能将流行性误认为正确性：一个虚假但高频的未经验证共识可能成为有偏奖励信号，导致测试时强化学习强化频繁但错误的答案，并陷入不正确的模式。我们通过T$^3$RL（测试时强化学习的工具验证）解决这种虚假流行失败模式，这是一个验证感知的测试时强化学习框架。T$^3$RL将伪标签构建基于外部工具证据。具体而言，验证器利用外部工具证据（例如，来自代码执行）在验证感知投票中提升已验证轨迹的权重，从而为训练生成更可靠的伪标签。
tldr: T^3RL通过引入外部工具验证来纠正测试时强化学习中的虚假流行偏差，确保奖励信号基于实际证据而非单纯多数投票，从而提高模型正确性。
en_tdlr: T^3RL corrects false-popular biases in test-time reinforcement learning by incorporating external tool verification, ensuring reward signals rely on actual evidence rather than mere majority voting to enhance model correctness.
